user.title: SPAN Panel (eBus)
user.description: How do you want to add SPAN?

menu_options.local: A panel on my network (firmware r202639 or later)
menu_options.cloud: My SPAN account, over the cloud

cloud.title: Sign in to SPAN
cloud.description:
Sign in with your SPAN account. Your password is used once to obtain access tokens and is never stored.

Setup registers this Home Assistant install as a telemetry client and waits for the first live frame before finishing, so it may take up to a minute.

local_pick.title: Choose your panel
local_pick.description: These SPAN panels were found on your network. Pick one, or enter an address yourself.

local_host.title: Find your panel
local_host.description: Enter the panel's IP address or hostname. The panel needs firmware r202639 or later.

local_unsupported.title: Local API not available
local_unsupported.description: This panel doesn't offer SPAN's local API yet; it arrives with firmware r202639. You can add your SPAN account over the cloud instead, or try another address.

local_auth.title: Enter the panel passphrase
local_auth.description:
Find the passphrase in the SPAN app, under the panel's settings. It is used once to register Home Assistant with the panel and is never stored.

The panel at {host} presented a certificate authority with fingerprint:
`{fingerprint}`

cloud_fallback.title: Use the cloud as a fallback?
cloud_fallback.description: Home Assistant now talks to the panel directly. Signing in to your SPAN account as well lets it fall back to the cloud when the panel can't be reached locally.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in for the cloud fallback (recommended)
menu_options.local_only: Local only: never use the cloud

reauth_local.title: Re-register with the panel
reauth_local.description:
The panel at {host} no longer accepts Home Assistant's credentials. Enter the passphrase from the SPAN app to register again; it is never stored.

Certificate authority fingerprint:
`{fingerprint}`

reconfigure.title: Change the panel address
reconfigure.description: Enter the panel's new IP address or hostname. The panel there must present the same certificate authority as before.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SPAN
reauth_confirm.description: Your SPAN session expired. Sign in again to refresh access.

panels.title: Choose your panels
panels.description: These panels are on your SPAN account. Tick the ones that belong to this Home Assistant.

feed.title: What feeds each panel?
feed.description: Choose how each panel gets its power. Most panels have their own supply.

feed_circuit.title: Which circuit feeds this panel?
feed_circuit.description: Choose the circuit on {upstream} that feeds {panel}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SPAN cloud. Please try again.
error.no_telemetry: Signed in, but SPAN published no telemetry within the setup timeout. Check that your panel is online in the SPAN mobile app, then try again.
error.feed_cycle: Panels can't feed each other. Check the answers for a loop.
error.rate_limited: The panel is limiting requests. Wait {retry_after} seconds and try again.
error.invalid_passphrase: The panel didn't accept that passphrase.
error.panel_not_ready: The panel isn't ready yet. Try again in a minute.
error.broker_auth: The panel registered Home Assistant but its broker refused the login. Try again.
error.panel_unreachable: Could not reach the panel at that address.
error.no_ready_state: Connected to the panel, but it didn't report ready in time. Try again.
error.ca_mismatch: The device at that address isn't this panel, or couldn't be reached.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs and try again.
error.not_a_panel: The device at that address doesn't look like a SPAN panel.

abort.already_configured: This SPAN panel or account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials are for a different SPAN account than the one being re-authenticated.
abort.already_in_progress: This panel is already being set up.
abort.not_local: Only panels added over the local API have an address to change.
abort.cloud_account_configured: This SPAN account is already set up over the cloud. Remove that entry first, then add the panel locally.
abort.panel_configured_locally: A panel on this SPAN account is already set up locally, with this account as its cloud fallback. Remove that entry first to add the whole account over the cloud.
abort.panel_not_on_account: This panel isn't on that SPAN account.
abort.not_supported: This panel's firmware doesn't offer the local API yet.

transport.title: Connection
transport.description: Choose whether this panel may fall back to your SPAN account over the cloud when its local connection is lost.

init.title: Choose your panels
init.description: Tick the panels on your SPAN account that belong to this Home Assistant.

confirm_remove.title: Remove panels?
confirm_remove.description: This removes {count} device(s) and their entities from Home Assistant. Saved energy totals are kept, so ticking a panel again resumes them.

feed.title: What feeds each panel?
feed.description: Choose how each panel gets its power. Most panels have their own supply.

feed_circuit.title: Which circuit feeds this panel?
feed_circuit.description: Choose the circuit on {upstream} that feeds {panel}.

error.feed_cycle: Panels can't feed each other. Check the answers for a loop.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SPAN cloud. Please try again.
abort.not_cloud_account: Panels added locally without a SPAN account have no options yet.

new_panels.title: New SPAN panel found
new_panels.description: {count} panel(s) on your SPAN account are not set up here. To add or dismiss them, open the SPAN Panel (eBus) integration, select Configure and tick the panels that belong to this Home Assistant.

transport_fallback.title: {title} is using the cloud
transport_fallback.description: Home Assistant lost its local connection to {title} over an hour ago and is reading the panel through the SPAN cloud. Check that the panel is powered and on your network; if its address changed, select Reconfigure on the entry. It moves back to the local connection by itself once that has been healthy for five minutes.

options.local_first: Local, falling back to the cloud

local_unavailable.message: The panel is not reachable on its local API right now, so the command was not sent.

not_settable.message: The panel does not accept changes to this setting.

bad_value.message: The panel does not accept that value for this setting.

command_not_sent.message: The command could not be sent to the panel. Check its connection and try again.
